reason: An agent evaluation platform that runs benchmark trials, analyzes session traces, computes scripted and LLM-judged metrics, imports logs, and produces reports and A/B comparisons.

summaries.zh: 用于运行智能体基准测试、分析会话轨迹、计算脚本和模型评审指标，并生成报告及运行对比结果。
summaries.en: Runs agent benchmarks, analyzes session traces, computes scripted and model-judged metrics, and generates reports and run comparisons.

capabilities: Executes headless dsh subprocesses for benchmark trials
Reads and reconstructs persisted session logs as traces
Runs scripted checks and optional LLM-based grading
Generates reports and compares evaluation runs
